# BookShelf

> BookShelf is a free web app and Progressive Web App (PWA) for cataloging your personal book library and sharing books with friends.

## What it does
- Add books from your home library by photographing the cover, scanning the ISBN, or typing manually
- AI-powered book recognition fills in title, author, description, and cover automatically
- Lend books to friends and track the full lending workflow (request → approve → handoff → return)
- Buy and sell books between friends in EUR, USD, GBP, RON, or MDL
- Follow a social feed of what friends are reading
- Track reading progress and receive daily AI-generated reading insights
- Multilingual: English, Romanian, Russian

## Who it's for
People who own physical books and want to organize, share, and lend them to friends.

## Pricing
- Free forever: up to 10 books
- Unlimited: $1/month or $10/year
- No ads, no data selling

## Technical
- Web app installable as a PWA on iOS and Android
- Available at https://bookshelf.name
